# Product glossary 0.1.0

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/check_content.py --write-views` from product/content/glossary.json; do not edit by hand. -->

> **Status: proposed.** Every value below is proposed by the implementing session of PenniLogic/docs#84 and awaits confirmation by its owner. Comprehension evidence for the flagged terms is held by PenniLogic/docs#66; no term is approved.

| ID | Preferred label | Definition | Surfaces | Forbidden aliases | Comprehension | Status | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `term.transaction` | transaction | A single movement of money into or out of one of your accounts, recorded once even when it is seen in more than one place. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | txn | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.debt` | debt | Money you owe to a lender or person, with its balance, interest rate, minimum payment, term and fees. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | dues | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.principal` | principal | The part of a debt balance that is the borrowed money itself, not interest or fees. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | capital owed | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.interest` | interest | The cost of borrowing that a lender adds to a debt over time, set by its rate. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | finance charge | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.minimum_payment` | minimum payment | The smallest payment a lender accepts for a debt in a billing period; paying only this usually costs more interest over time. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | minimum due | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.apr` | APR | Annual percentage rate: the yearly interest rate a lender charges on a debt, shown as a percentage. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | rate of return | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.payoff` | payoff date | The date a debt or all debts would be fully repaid if the shown payments continue as planned. It is a calculation, not a promise. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | debt-free date | required, evidence pending:PenniLogic/docs#66 | provisional | content |
| `term.available` | available | Money the app shows as free to use after known bills, reserved amounts and pending transactions; it is not a bank balance. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | spare cash | required, evidence pending:PenniLogic/docs#66 | provisional | content |
| `term.projected` | projected | A figure calculated from your own data and stated assumptions about the future; it can change when the data or assumptions change. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | predicted | required, evidence pending:PenniLogic/docs#66 | provisional | content |
| `term.stale` | last updated | Marks figures that are shown from the last saved data and may not reflect recent changes; the time of the last update is shown with them. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | outdated | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.pending` | pending | A transaction that has started but has not settled; its final value or date can still change. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | uncleared | required, evidence pending:PenniLogic/docs#66 | provisional | content |
| `term.reversed` | reversed | A transaction undone to correct the record, for example a duplicate entry; it stays visible, is linked to its correction and is never a refund. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | voided | required, evidence pending:PenniLogic/docs#66 | provisional | content |
| `term.aggregate` | aggregate | A combined total across several accounts, members or categories that does not show the individual items behind it. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | rollup | required, evidence pending:PenniLogic/docs#66 | provisional | content |
| `term.shared` | shared | Data one member has chosen to let another member see, category by category and person by person. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.revoked` | revoked | Sharing or access that has been ended; the other person no longer sees the data, including earlier copies. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | none | required, evidence pending:PenniLogic/docs#66 | provisional | content |
| `term.refund` | refund | Money returned for an earlier payment, in full or in part; it is a new transaction linked to that payment, never a reversal, and is not income. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.consent` | consent | A choice you make to allow a specific use of your data; you can withdraw it at any time. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.permission` | device permission | Access to a phone feature, such as messages or notifications, that you can allow or deny in device settings. | android, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.access_log` | access log | A record you can see of who viewed your detailed data and when. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.support_access` | support access | Time-limited access to a member's records that a support operator requests with a stated reason tied to a support ticket; the member is told and it ends on its own. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.audit_log` | audit log | An append-only record of operator actions that operators cannot change or delete. | admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.two_person_approval` | two-person approval | A rule that a high-sensitivity operator action needs a second operator to approve it before it runs. | admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.data_export` | data export | A full copy of your data that you can download in a readable format. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.account_deletion` | account deletion | Permanently removing your account and its data, with any legally required records kept only as long as required. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.plan` | plan | The subscription level of an account and the features and limits it includes. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | tier | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.ai_insight` | AI insight | An explanation or summary written by an AI model from your own data; figures in it come from the app's calculations, never from the model. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.own_ai_provider` | your own AI provider | An AI service you connect with your own provider credentials or address instead of the managed service. | android, web, support | byok | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.split` | split | A shared expense divided between group members in equal, exact, percentage or share amounts. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.settlement` | settlement | A recorded payment between group members that reduces what one owes another. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | none | not required | provisional | content |
| `term.scenario` | scenario | An illustrative calculation of what would happen under choices you select; it is information, not advice. | android, web, admin, contracts, support | recommendation | not required | provisional | content |
